1.name: Inspired Scholarship
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3396|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7440|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3304|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3372|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff8980|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff4216|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff7914|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Relentless Focus
5.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff15181|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3943|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.
